# Prose cadence

Read the passage aloud. Mark where the reader needs time to follow a mechanism and where an observation can land in a short sentence. If the existing rhythm serves both, return the passage as written.

## Protect meaning first

Work from the verified draft and the author’s voice guidance. Mark any facts a rewrite could accidentally strengthen or lose, including attribution, numbers, denominators, units, negation, tense, scope, causal strength and uncertainty. Keep exact quotations and identifiers intact. If a factual question arises, flag it for the author’s evidence pass before polishing the claim.

## Choose a small change

Use at most three devices in a piece. Zero is a valid choice. A repeated grammatical frame can make comparable events easier to follow. Shortening successive clauses can carry the reader toward a result. A longer sentence can hold the stages of a mechanism together when breaking it up would hide their relationship. A paragraph break gives an observation room after a dense explanation.

Use one accelerating sequence or one short run of repetition where it helps the subject. Bring in a different register at a section boundary only when the material supplies that voice, such as a genuine field observation or an exact message from an instrument. Preserve the author’s register elsewhere.

For example, a plausible source sentence reads, “At startup the sensor reported a gap, and the operator waited for a second reading before opening the valve.” A pause can make the sequence easier to hear: “At startup the sensor reported a gap. The operator waited for a second reading before opening the valve.” Changing “reported” to “found” would turn an instrument reading into a confirmed condition.

## Read back against the original

Compare the changed clauses with the source. Can a reader still tell who observed the event, under what conditions, and how certain they were? Remove any line that exists only to complete a pattern. Read the surrounding paragraph for accidental repetition and return the revised passage in the form requested. Flag unresolved evidence questions separately. Apply the author’s final copyedit after the rhythm pass.
